description: This file contains a PHP trait named FootprintRelationsTrait that provides methods for managing Footprint relationships in models. The trait includes functions to add, replace, retrieve, and remove footprints associated with a model, leveraging a specific relational table pattern. It is used to abstract footprint relationship handling across various models that follow the naming conventions described in the comments.

methods.name: getFootprintRelationalTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship table based on the model's table name, following the naming convention.

methods.name: addFootprints
methods.description: Adds one or multiple footprints to the model, with an option to remove footprints not in the list.

methods.name: replaceFootprints
methods.description: Replaces all existing footprints with a new set by removing old ones and adding new footprints.

methods.name: getFootprints
methods.description: Retrieves all footprints associated with the model, optionally with language-specific data.

methods.name: removeFootprints
methods.description: Removes specific footprints from the model.

methods.name: getMainFootprint
methods.description: Returns the primary footprint associated with the model, if any.
